properties.description: Each page of the site (site/index.html, site/setup.html) ends with "Checked against reflow2 vX.Y.Z." tools/check_doc_versions.py holds that line as a claim for each page, so CI fails when a page names any release but the one being built. Moving the line is the cut's promise that the page was read again for what the release ships. Built 2026-10-09 in the v0.81.0 cut, where the pages were brought up to date for the first time: the front page's one-brain section says what the hub now does across repositories, and the VS Code setup names .reflow2.toml and how to keep a design for a repository you do not own. LIMIT: the gate checks that the line moved, not that the content is right; reading the pages again is still the person's or agent's step.
properties.name: A cut brings the site up to date, and the version gate reads the release each site page names
